summary: Phase 2a Reviews & 5-star Ratings — backend + frontend end-to-end verified. Added 8 new backend pytest cases (all pass) covering upsert, guards, list, delete, and inline rating fields on list/detail/provider endpoints. Existing 19 marketplace tests still green (27/27 total). Frontend flow tested with Playwright as anon, renter, and owner accounts on /services, /services/gig/:id, /services/provider/:userId.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/marketplace.py: `_rating_aggregate` and `_batch_rating_aggregate` return `rating_avg: None` when no reviews — UI already guards on `rating_count > 0` before rendering, so this is fine; but consider exporting 0.0 instead of None to keep the field non-null in OpenAPI clients.

GigDetail.jsx: `deleteMine` uses browser `window.confirm` implicitly via toast? No — the code calls delete directly with no confirm dialog in the source I reviewed; if a confirm was intended before withdraw, add one. (Currently works: click withdraw → immediate delete.)
list_reviews issues one users.find_one per review row — fine at Phase 2a scale, but consider a $lookup or batched user fetch once a gig has 20+ reviews.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 UI scenarios in review request passed)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing owner-owned TEST_ gigs. All reviews created during tests are self-cleaned via `_cleanup_renter_review` fixture and explicit withdraw at end of E2E flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reviews Phase 2a is fully green. Test IDs to know: gig-reviews-section, gig-review-form, gig-review-star-1..5 (interactive), gig-review-comment, gig-review-submit, gig-review-delete, gig-reviews-empty, gig-review-{uuid} (rendered row), gig-header-stars-row/-label, gig-avg-stars-row/-label, gig-stars-{gigId}-row (Services home), provider-gig-stars-{gigId}-row (ProviderProfile). Backend endpoints: GET/POST /api/marketplace/gigs/{id}/reviews, DELETE /api/marketplace/gigs/{id}/reviews/mine. Reviews are single-per-user upserts (POST twice returns same review_id, updates rating). Owner cannot review own gig → 400. Non-existent gig → 404. Unauth POST → 401/403 (verify_token). Rating validation: 1-5 inclusive, else 422 (Pydantic ge/le). rating_avg is rounded to 1 decimal; null when count==0. Sample IDs used in E2E: gig 789a5c0c-ac27-4c30-9e40-4f16095837d0 (owner's TEST_in_platform), provider b0a59336-f059-4d91-b608-6bbedc63a775.
rca of the issue: No issues found — Phase 2a is production-ready.
